name: AMD Radeon VII product page (Wayback capture, spec table)
notes: Live amd.com URL 404s, so every figure comes from the Wayback capture of the AMD product-page spec table. Quoted rows: Compute Units 60, Base Frequency 1400 MHz, Boost Frequency up to 1750 MHz, Peak Frequency up to 1800 MHz, Peak Half Precision Compute Performance 27.7 TFLOPs, Peak Single Precision Compute Performance 13.8 TFLOPs, Peak Double Precision Compute Performance 3.46 TFLOPs, Stream Processors 3840, Transistor Count 13.2 B, Typical Board Power (Desktop) 300 W, Memory Speed 4 Gbps, Max Memory Size 16 GB, Memory Type HBM2, Memory Interface 4096-bit, Memory Bandwidth up to 1024 GB/s, Launch Date 2019, Product Family AMD Radeon 2nd generation Vega. 4 Gbps times 4096-bit divided by 8 equals 2048 GB/s, which does not equal the printed 1024 GB/s; both numbers are kept and the disagreement is noted on the accelerator rather than resolved. No sparsity footnote is printed, so the TFLOP rows are taken as dense.
